---
title: "Get Your Own MISP Instance"
---

This chapter helps you get your own MISP instance up and running. There are
several ways to deploy MISP depending on whether you want a quick evaluation or a
production instance; the authoritative, always-current instructions live on the
[MISP project download page](https://www.misp-project.org/download/) and in the
[MISP repository](https://github.com/MISP/MISP).

The book's **Installation Guides** cover a [new Ubuntu 24.04 installation](../install-ubuntu/index.qmd)
and the [offline database upgrade from MISP 2.5 to 3.0](../upgrade-2-5-to-3-0/index.qmd).

## Choosing a deployment method

*   **Official installer** — use the [Ubuntu guide](../install-ubuntu/index.qmd)
    for a clean MISP 3.0 development-branch installation on your own host.
    Check the [download page](https://www.misp-project.org/download/) for other
    supported release and operating system combinations.
*   **Docker** — for MISP 3.0 early access, use the
    [`misp-3.0_wip` branch of misp-docker](https://github.com/MISP/misp-docker/tree/misp-3.0_wip)
    and build the images locally; no pre-built images are published for this deployment.
    Follow [Quick Start](../quick-start/index.qmd#start-misp-with-docker) for the configuration and build steps.
*   **Cloud images** — MISP can be deployed from cloud/marketplace images and with
    infrastructure-as-code; see the download page for the current options.

Whichever method you choose, keep the instance updated (see the
[FAQ](../faq/index.qmd) and [updating the Python libraries](../updating-python/index.qmd)),
and review the [requirements](../requirements/index.qmd) chapter for the supported
software versions.
